title: Dynamic Shift Environment Configuration
description: Schema for configuring dynamic shift injection in EvoPolicyGym environments.

shift_step.description: The environment step at which the dynamic shift occurs. Default is typically a majority of the budget (e.g., 0.7 * max_steps).

shift_type.description: The type of environmental change to inject.

magnitude.description: The intensity of the shift (0.0 = no change, 1.0 = maximal disruption).

enabled.description: Whether the dynamic shift is active for this run.

pre_shift_config.description: Optional specific overrides for the environment state before the shift.

post_shift_config.description: Optional specific overrides for the environment state after the shift.
